Every artefact CSOAI holds across this repository, Hugging Face, GitHub, Kaggle and Oracle Object Storage, committed to one Merkle root. Read it as a census, never as evidence: INDEXED means we found the artefact and measured nothing against it, and UNSIGNED means a card body exists carrying signature: null awaiting a signing decision.
